item.title: Asian nations ramp up coal power amid Middle East energy crunch
item.summary: With Iran effectively turning the Strait of Hormuz into a toll gate, energy shortages are worsening across Asia. Amid the supply crunch, countries are increasingly turning back to coal for electricity, potentially slowing efforts to tackle climate change.

item.title: Artemis II: Astronauts send first pictures of Earth as rocket leaves orbit
item.summary: The #ArtemisII astronauts have left #Earth's orbit, becoming the first humans to do so since 1972. They are now headed for the #Moon, which they will fly around in the coming days.

item.title: Weak enforcement blamed for building collapse that killed four in Ghana
item.summary: In Ghana, schools have been suspended in the region where an unfinished school building collapsed, killing four children and injuring about 30 others in the capital, Accra. FRANCE 24’s Justice Baidoo reports.
